study_identification_part.si_4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ADNI-3: 730 participants from North America across 7 acquisition protocols (S31, S55, S127, P33, P36, GE36, GE54); NIMHANS: 302 Indian-ancestry participants from National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences in Bangalore, India, scanned at two scanners (Philips 3T Ingenia and Siemens 3T Skyra); TractoInferno: 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from publicly available training dataset used for pretraining.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "In total, we analyzed diffusion data of 1032 subjects from two cohorts - 730 participants from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) Phase 3 collected using seven acquisition protocols and an independent sample of 302 Indian-ancestry participants, evaluated and scanned at two scanners at the National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS) in Bangalore, India." ... "In our study, this pretraining dataset consisted of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes already preprocessed from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset"
